title: 1994–95 Mexican Primera División season
text: The following are statistics of Mexican Primera División, the premier football division in Mexico, for the 1994–95 season.

title: Sultanes de Monterrey win the Mexican League.
text: The Sultanes de Monterrey are a professional baseball club in the Mexican League (LMB) based in Monterrey, Nuevo León. Established in 1939 as Carta Blanca, the Sultanes have won ten LMB titles, most recently in 2018.

title: 1995 ITU Triathlon World Championships, is held in Cancún.
text: The 1995 ITU Triathlon World Championships was a triathlon event held in Cancún, Mexico on 12 November 1995, organised by the International Triathlon Union. The course was a 1.5 kilometres swim, 40 kilometres (25 mi) bike, 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) run.

title: CMLL 62nd Anniversary Show
text: The CMLL 62nd Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on September 22, 1995 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico.
